description: Search Zonaprop Argentina by search URL, location, property type and operation type using public server-rendered pages. No browser or account required.

location.description: City or neighborhood slug as it appears in ZonaProp URLs. Examples: capital-federal, palermo, cordoba, rosario. Ignored if Search URL is provided.
location.title: Location

maxResults.description: Maximum number of listings to scrape.
maxResults.title: Max Results

operationType.description: Whether to search for sale, rent, or temporary rental listings. Ignored if Search URL is provided.
operationType.title: Operation Type

propertyType.description: Type of property to search for. Ignored if Search URL is provided.
propertyType.title: Property Type

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy. Direct browser-fingerprinted requests are the default; free Apify Proxy is tried if the site blocks the runner.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

searchUrl.description: ZonaProp search URL. Example: https://www.zonaprop.com.ar/departamentos-venta-capital-federal.html. Takes priority over the filters below if provided.
searchUrl.title: Search URL

title: Zonaprop Argentina Property Search & Geolocation Scraper Input
